description: C++ Programming — From fundamentals to compiler internals

topics.name: Fundamental Data Types
topics.prompt: lets talk about all fundamental data types in cpp, int, float, double, char, bool, void, wchar_t, size_t, their sizes, ranges, and when to use each one

topics.name: Type Casting
topics.prompt: explain static_cast, dynamic_cast, const_cast, reinterpret_cast in cpp with examples of when each is needed and pitfalls

topics.name: Auto and Decltype
topics.prompt: how does auto type deduction work in cpp, what about decltype, trailing return types, and auto with references and const

topics.name: Type Traits
topics.prompt: explain type traits in cpp like is_integral, is_floating_point, is_same, enable_if, how SFINAE uses them for template metaprogramming

topics.name: Control Flow Statements
topics.prompt: lets go deep into cpp control flow, if else, switch with fallthrough, for while do-while loops, range-based for, goto and when its actually used, ternary operator edge cases

topics.name: Functions and Overloading
topics.prompt: explain pass by value vs reference vs pointer in cpp, default arguments, function overloading resolution rules, inline functions, and why the compiler sometimes ignores inline

topics.name: Lambda Expressions
topics.prompt: deep dive into cpp lambdas, capture by value vs reference, mutable lambdas, generic lambdas, immediately invoked lambdas, and lambda vs std::function performance

topics.name: Variadic Functions and Templates
topics.prompt: explain variadic functions with va_list in c-style and variadic templates in modern cpp, parameter packs, fold expressions, recursive template expansion

topics.name: Raw Pointers
topics.prompt: explain raw pointers in cpp, pointer arithmetic, pointer to pointer, void pointers, function pointers, dangling pointers, and common pointer bugs

topics.name: Smart Pointers
topics.prompt: deep dive into unique_ptr, shared_ptr, weak_ptr in cpp, control block internals, custom deleters, make_shared vs new, circular reference problem and how weak_ptr solves it

topics.name: RAII Pattern
topics.prompt: what is RAII in cpp, how constructors and destructors manage resources, examples with file handles, mutex locks, database connections, and why RAII is cpp's answer to garbage collection

topics.name: Memory Management
topics.prompt: new vs malloc in cpp, placement new, memory alignment, memory leaks detection, valgrind, address sanitizer, and custom allocators

topics.name: Classes and Constructors
topics.prompt: explain cpp classes, default constructor, parameterized, copy constructor deep vs shallow copy, move constructor, delegating constructors, and explicit keyword

topics.name: Destructors and Rule of 3/5/0
topics.prompt: cpp destructors, virtual destructors, rule of three, rule of five, rule of zero, when you need each, and what happens if you violate these rules

topics.name: Inheritance
topics.prompt: single inheritance, multiple inheritance, virtual inheritance, diamond problem in cpp, how vtable resolves virtual dispatch, and access specifiers with inheritance

topics.name: Polymorphism
topics.prompt: compile time vs runtime polymorphism in cpp, function overloading, operator overloading, virtual functions, pure virtual functions, abstract classes, vtable and vptr internals

topics.name: Operator Overloading
topics.prompt: operator overloading in cpp, arithmetic operators, comparison, stream insertion extraction, assignment, subscript, function call operator, and rules about which can be overloaded

topics.name: Friend Functions and Classes
topics.prompt: friend functions and friend classes in cpp, when and why to use them, how they break encapsulation, and alternatives to friend

topics.name: Static Members
topics.prompt: static member variables and static member functions in cpp, static initialization order fiasco, meyers singleton pattern, and thread safety of static locals

topics.name: Function Templates
topics.prompt: function templates in cpp, template argument deduction, explicit specialization, partial ordering rules, and how the compiler generates code from templates

topics.name: Class Templates
topics.prompt: class templates in cpp, template parameters (type, non-type, template template), default template arguments, and dependent names with typename keyword

topics.name: Template Specialization
topics.prompt: full specialization vs partial specialization of templates in cpp, when to use each, how the compiler selects specializations, and common patterns like type traits

topics.name: SFINAE
topics.prompt: what is SFINAE in cpp, substitution failure is not an error, how enable_if works, void_t pattern, detection idiom, and how concepts replaced SFINAE in cpp20

topics.name: Concepts C++20
topics.prompt: cpp20 concepts, requires clauses, requires expressions, standard concepts like integral and floating_point, how to write custom concepts, and how they improve error messages vs SFINAE

topics.name: STL Vector
topics.prompt: std::vector internals in cpp, dynamic array growth strategy, capacity vs size, reserve vs resize, emplace_back vs push_back, iterator invalidation rules, and memory layout

topics.name: STL Deque and List
topics.prompt: std::deque internal block structure vs std::list doubly linked list in cpp, when to choose each, performance comparison, iterator stability, and memory overhead

topics.name: STL Set and Map
topics.prompt: std::set and std::map red-black tree internals in cpp, insert find erase complexity, custom comparators, std::multiset, std::multimap, and lower_bound upper_bound usage

topics.name: STL Unordered Containers
topics.prompt: unordered_set and unordered_map hash table internals in cpp, bucket arrays, load factor, rehashing, custom hash functions, and collision resolution chaining

topics.name: STL Stack Queue Priority Queue
topics.prompt: std::stack, std::queue, std::priority_queue as container adapters in cpp, underlying containers, custom comparators for priority queue, and when to use each

topics.name: STL Array Bitset Pair Tuple
topics.prompt: std::array vs c-style array, std::bitset operations, std::pair and std::tuple, structured bindings, std::tie, and std::get with compile time indexing

topics.name: STL Algorithms Sorting
topics.prompt: std::sort introsort, stable_sort merge sort, partial_sort heap, nth_element in cpp, complexity guarantees, custom comparators, and when to pick each

topics.name: STL Algorithms Searching
topics.prompt: binary_search, lower_bound, upper_bound, equal_range, find, find_if, count, count_if in cpp, preconditions for binary search algorithms, and linear vs logarithmic complexity

topics.name: STL Algorithms Transformations
topics.prompt: transform, accumulate, reduce, inner_product, partial_sum, adjacent_difference in cpp, and parallel execution policies from cpp17

topics.name: STL Algorithms Permutations
topics.prompt: next_permutation, prev_permutation, partition, stable_partition, partition_point, rotate, reverse, unique, remove_if erase idiom in cpp

topics.name: Iterators Deep Dive
topics.prompt: iterator categories in cpp, input output forward bidirectional random access, iterator traits, reverse iterators, insert iterators back_inserter front_inserter, stream iterators, and custom iterator implementation

topics.name: Linked List Implementation
topics.prompt: implement singly linked list, doubly linked list, circular linked list from scratch in cpp, insert delete search reverse operations, and edge cases

topics.name: Stack and Queue Implementation
topics.prompt: implement stack using array and linked list, queue using array and linked list, circular queue, double ended queue from scratch in cpp

topics.name: Binary Tree and BST
topics.prompt: implement binary tree, binary search tree in cpp, insert search delete, inorder preorder postorder level-order traversal, height balanced check, and lowest common ancestor

topics.name: AVL Tree
topics.prompt: AVL tree implementation in cpp, rotations left right left-right right-left, balance factor, insert and delete with rebalancing, and time complexity analysis

topics.name: Red-Black Tree

topics.name: B-Tree and B+ Tree
topics.prompt: B-tree and B+ tree structure in cpp, why they are used in databases and file systems, insertion splitting, deletion merging, minimum degree, and disk access optimization

topics.name: Trie Data Structure
topics.prompt: trie prefix tree implementation in cpp, insert search delete, space optimization with compressed trie, applications in autocomplete, spell check, and IP routing

topics.name: Segment Tree
topics.prompt: segment tree for range queries in cpp, build query update operations, lazy propagation, persistent segment tree, and applications like range min max sum

topics.name: Fenwick Tree BIT

topics.name: Disjoint Set Union-Find
topics.prompt: union-find disjoint set data structure in cpp, union by rank, path compression, inverse Ackermann amortized complexity, and applications in Kruskal and connected components

topics.name: Hash Table Implementation

topics.name: Skip List
topics.prompt: skip list probabilistic data structure in cpp, multi-level linked list, insert search delete with expected O(log n), comparison with balanced BSTs, and randomized algorithms

topics.name: Bloom Filter
topics.prompt: bloom filter probabilistic data structure in cpp, false positive rate calculation, multiple hash functions, bit array, applications in caching and databases, and counting bloom filters

topics.name: Bubble Selection Insertion Sort

topics.name: Merge Sort

topics.name: Quick Sort
topics.prompt: quick sort implementation in cpp, partition schemes Lomuto vs Hoare, pivot selection strategies random median-of-three, worst case, tail call optimization, and 3-way partitioning for duplicates

topics.name: Heap Sort
topics.prompt: heap sort using max-heap in cpp, in-place sorting, build heap O(n), overall O(n log n), not stable, and comparison with merge sort and quick sort

topics.name: Graph Representation

topics.name: BFS and DFS
topics.prompt: breadth-first search and depth-first search implementation in cpp, iterative vs recursive DFS, BFS for shortest path in unweighted graph, DFS for cycle detection, and connected components

topics.name: Dijkstra Algorithm

topics.name: Bellman-Ford Algorithm

topics.name: Minimum Spanning Tree

topics.name: Topological Sort

topics.name: Strongly Connected Components

topics.name: Network Flow
